session.title: Chat Session
session.description: A chat session containing metadata about the user's conversation

title.description: The custom or generated title of the chat session

userId.description: The Firebase Authentication UID of the owner

date.description: The formatted text date of when the session was created

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp representing the creation time

message.title: Message
message.description: An individual message within a chat session

content.description: The text content of the message containing markdown

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp representing when the message was sent

skill.title: Custom Skill
skill.description: A custom AI skill or system persona created by the user

userId.description: The UID of the user who owns this custom skill

name.description: The friendly display name of the skill

description.description: Short description of what the skill does

isPublic.description: Whether this skill is shared in the cloud hub with others

authorEmail.description: The email address of the skill's author

/sessions/{sessionId}/messages/{messageI.description: Stores individual messages belonging to a chat session

/skills/{skillId}.description: Stores custom skill entities created by users
